confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Phuket tourist-area pricing for a July low-season window; not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Accommodation and drink anchors are less certain than meal anchors; cocktail and wine_glass lean on the beer anchor (about 2.4x and 2.1x) because direct bar-price knowledge is weaker. The FX observation came from search summaries of rba.gov.au, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Thailand's other beach and island resort towns (for example Krabi and Koh Samui) and Bangkok's tourist-facing mid-range prices. Restaurant and bar anchors reflect Phuket's tourist-area level rather than rural Thai rates; accommodation anchors are set below peak-season levels because July falls in Phuket's low season.
